# NEXORA diagnostic catalog distribution

`nexora-diagnostic-catalog-0.1.0.tgz` is the generated Node package from
[`pythonsmethod/nexora-core` PR #2](https://github.com/pythonsmethod/nexora-core/pull/2),
merged as `dcdc27ecbb37568866199203fec1023bd53d7799`. Its 33 input files
were checked byte for byte against their GitHub blobs before the package was
built offline with `npm run build:catalog` and `npm pack`.

Package version: `0.1.0`; data version: `pmc-catalog-2026-09-28-v0.1`.
Tarball SHA-256: `227a12c1e4fd6333a6ce06bce7f7e64339bd35c4c428d8909da357d8f304a491`.
The npm integrity in `package-lock.json` pins the exact artifact. PMC has no
private NEXORA Git dependency or runtime API dependency. On update, generate
and pin a new artifact and preserve the source commit and licenses here.

Attribution and redistribution terms are in [licenses/ATTRIBUTIONS.md](licenses/ATTRIBUTIONS.md),
[LOINC license](licenses/license.txt), [LOINC notice](licenses/LOINC_short_license.txt),
and [UCUM license](licenses/ucum_license.txt). The same files are inside the tarball.
